dashboard.label: SOC - Wazuh Overview
dashboard.description: Local SOC view of de-duplicated high-severity Wazuh alerts.

search.query: index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | stats count by rule_id rule_level rule_description | sort - count
index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | timechart span=30m count by rule_id

index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert incident_id=* | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen count values(event_id) as event_ids values(event_type) as event_types values(rule_id) as rules values(rule_level) as levels values(agent) as agents by incident_id | sort - last_seen | table first_seen last_seen incident_id count event_ids event_types rules levels agents

index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | spath input=_raw path=source output=event_source | eval event_source=coalesce(event_source,"endpoint") | eval lab_text=lower(coalesce(event_id,"")." ".coalesce(message,"")." ".coalesce(script_block,"")) | where rule_level>=12 AND NOT match(lab_text,"synthetic|selftest|correlation|lab[-_ ]|watcher[-_ ]test|live[-_]bridge") | eval event_key=if(isnull(event_id) OR event_id="",alert_key,event_id) | dedup event_key | eval script_preview=if(len(script_block)>240,substr(script_block,1,240)."...",script_block) | sort - _time | table _time timestamp event_source event_id event_type outcome severity message agent agent_id rule_id rule_level rule_description image targetFilename process_guid process_id parent_image command_line user script_preview

index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert rule_id=92213 | eval path=coalesce(targetFilename,target) | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen count values(path) as targetFilename values(image) as image values(process_guid) as process_guid values(process_id) as process_id values(parent_image) as parent_image values(command_line) as command_line values(user) as user by alert_key agent agent_id rule_id rule_level rule_description | sort - last_seen | table first_seen last_seen count agent agent_id rule_id rule_level rule_description image targetFilename process_guid process_id parent_image command_line user alert_key

index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | sort - _time | table _time timestamp agent agent_id rule_id rule_level rule_description image targetFilename process_guid process_id parent_image command_line user script_block
